The expected busiest-link load is about 1.337 times the mean.

This is a balls-into-bins problem. Each of the 16 leaf switches hashes 448 flows onto 8 links, so the mean load per link is 56. The finish time is set by the maximum over all 128 link loads. A simple normal approximation, mean + σ·√(2 ln 128), lands in the same range, at about 1.35. I took the number from the `tail_latency` tool's ECMP closed form rather than running a separate Monte Carlo.
